Where to go

Pick your own journey.

Traveling to Brazil offers a kaleidoscope of experiences, from dancing to the infectious beats of samba in the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro to exploring the lush Amazon rainforest’s biodiversity. There’s a place in Brazil for everyone! Explore our selection of stunning destinations and uncover what makes each one of them unique.

Relax in any of our Sun & Beach getaways

Culture

Uncover the vibrant tapestry of our culture.

Gastronomy

Enjoy a culinary journey like no other.

Afro-tourism

Dive into the roots of African-Brazilian heritage.

Events and Festivities

Celebrate life like brazilians.

Cultural diversity and infectious passion define the Brazilian spirit. From internationally acclaimed sports events to globally recognized fashion weeks, and massive popular celebrations like Carnival, whenever we come together, it’s an unparalleled celebration. Explore with us the events that celebrate the cultural richness, captivating music, and warm hospitality of Brazil. Discover why Brazil is the stage for events that transcend borders and inspire global joy. The party is about to begin, and you are our honored guest!

Christmas light

Magic in the Heart of Serra Gaúcha

At the end of the year, Gramado is the place where the magic of Christmas comes to life, and the beautiful Serra Gaúcha transforms into an enchanted setting. Discover with us the history and attractions that make this event so special.

The Town

A Journey of Multisensory Experience

Having debuted in 2023, in São Paulo, The Town festival has established itself as a landmark cultural event, attracting audiences passionate about performances and presentations that seek to fuse renowned artists from different musical genres.

São Paulo LGBTQIA+ Parade

Celebration of diversity in the heart of the metropolis

Welcome to the São Paulo LGBTQIA+ Parade! This is the place where diversity, pride and celebration come together in the beating heart of Brazil’s largest metropolis.
